tutorial.welcome: Hey, REVO! I'm N.E.I.L., your mission companion. Let's explore Alpha Base together!
tutorial.movement: Use WASD or the arrow keys to move around. I'll be right here to help!
tutorial.exploration: Every room helps the base work as a team. Walk up to a station to learn what it does.
tutorial.communicationEntrance: The Communication Room is our main hub. The entrance is just ahead.
tutorial.interactionResult: Nice exploring, REVO! Each station helps the crew keep Alpha Base running.
tutorial.roomWelcome: We're in the Communication Room. This is where the crew checks messages and base status.
tutorial.briefingTerminal: This mission terminal holds the briefing and training notes. N.E.I.L. remains here to guide you in person.
tutorial.communicationsConsole: The communications console is for messages between Alpha Base and mission control. Replies from Earth can take time.
tutorial.missionStatus: This status display is a training prop. It is not connected to live mission or NASA data.
